doc.description: Onboard wind estimate from GPS ground speed while circling (fixed-wing). Port of the ground server's wind estimator (tmtc/wind.ml) to the autopilot: at constant airspeed the ground speed vectors over a turn lie on a circle whose centre is the wind vector. Needs only GPS; no pitot, magnetometer or datalink. Flight plan: call wind_circle_start(), circle until wind_circle.ready (about one turn), call wind_circle_stop(). The result is published to the state interface, so nav_drop, nav_compute_final_from_glide and other consumers of the state wind use it. wind_circle_upwind_course() gives the course flying into the wind.
